ExtraBar 1.4.0 – Deep Link Discovery & Batch Everything! 🔗✨

Find deep links for any app with an AI-ready prompt, and batch-edit across even more of ExtraBar — plus a round of reliability fixes.

✨ What's New

  • Find Deep Links Helper: Deep link actions now include a "Find Deep Links" card with a ready-made AI prompt — auto-filled with the app's name — that you can copy into any assistant to discover URL schemes and deep links, including actions surfaced by Raycast extensions!
  • Batch Editing Everywhere: Multi-select batch editing now extends to widget app menus and folder widgets, so you can move, copy, show, hide, or delete multiple items at once — just like on the bar!

⚡ Improvements

  • More Powerful Multi-Select: Bar multi-select now does more than move and copy — batch show, hide, and delete your selected items too!
  • Clearer Confirmations: Delete and remove confirmations now spell out that the action can't be undone and show the exact number of items being removed!
  • Inline Remove Button: Every item row now has an inline remove button for quick one-off deletions!
  • Copy Action Deep Link: Folder widget action items now offer "Copy Action Deep Link" so you can grab an action's link directly!
  • Correct Shiori Pricing: Shiori lifetime plans now display the correct full price instead of a mismatched or missing amount!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Search Keeps Focus: The searchable app action menu no longer loses keyboard focus — the search field stays focused as you type and results rebuild without jumping!
  • Reliable Shiori Sign-In: Fixed Shiori authentication so the sign-in flow completes reliably!
  • Stable Notch Position: The notch bar no longer keeps a stale position after disconnecting or reconnecting an external display — it recomputes its geometry on display changes!
  • Hidden Bars Stay Hidden: Hidden bars are no longer forced back to the front after a display reconfiguration!

🏷️ Renamed

  • "Move/Copy" is now "Select": The bar's button is renamed to "Select" since it now covers move, copy, show, hide, and delete — not just move and copy!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
